num_delivery_sites: <int> Number of candidate delivery sites that may be activated to serve customers.
num_customers: <int> Number of customers requiring delivery service.
vehicle_capacity: <int> Maximum number of pallets a single vehicle can carry on one tour.
num_vehicles: <int> Number of identical vehicles available in the fleet.

depot.id: <int> Identifier for the central depot node in the routing network.

delivery_sites.id: <int> Identifier for this delivery site node in the routing network.

customers.demand: <int> Number of pallets this customer requires.

routing_cost_matrix: <list[list[float]], shape [num_delivery_sites+1][num_delivery_sites+1]> Travel cost between each pair of nodes in the routing network, where row and column 0 is the depot and 1 through num_delivery_sites are the delivery sites.
assignment_cost_matrix: <list[list[float]], shape [num_customers][num_delivery_sites]> Travel cost for each customer to reach each candidate delivery site for pickup.
